GUARDED LOT-SUM FALLBACK, design A. A head changes only when the trigger fires and either path A or path B serves a sum. In every other case the head stays at today's figure.

T (trigger): the election admitted no procedure-scope figure, meaning each one is absent, refused or not-electable. Award copies (Lot(None), 492 (c)) count as lot figures here, not procedure figures. A sum also needs at least 2 lots, so T is exactly unit 1's class of 88 (B 84 + R 4). Nothing outside it can change.

A (537-vouched sum): use this path when a procedure figure F was refused by 537's lot-sum rule (F is about 10^k x a lot sum). Serve the electable lot sum that matches F under lot_sum_exponent. Kinds are tried in this order: 537's matched kind if it is electable, then awards, then BT-27-Lot (estimated_value), then BT-271-Lot (framework_maximum).
- A partner-only match (BT-709/BT-660, issue 506) is never served. It only points to the electable kind on the same scale. Example: 1024214 matched on BT-709 and serves the BT-271 sum, EUR 3.4 m.
- No repeat guard runs on this path, only the EUR 100 bn cap. The buyer's own total, slipped, is the sum. This is why 7427765 (6 equal EUR 500 k awards, each copied lot-null) is served EUR 3 m.

B (same-kind sum): otherwise, sum the lots in the kind of today's elected figure, in its currency.
- An award copy maps to awards. A head-lot estimated_value maps to estimated_value; framework_maximum to framework_maximum.
- If today's head is null, take the first of awards, estimated_value, framework_maximum that at least 2 lots carry.
- Each lot gives one figure, picked as elect.lot_sum does: the latest award, or the largest figure per field. Partner-only, withheld, sentinel and <= 10.00 figures are left out. Only Lots count; Parts count only in a head with no Lot; a LotsGroup never counts.
- The sum is converted with the head's own rate for that currency.

The sum is served unless one of these guards fires, checked in this order:
- **G0:** fewer than 2 lots, or the sum does not exceed today's figure. Equal means no change; smaller means the kinds disagree.
- **G7:** a procedure figure is withheld (372).
- **G5:** the sum is over EUR 100 bn, or any procedure or lot-null figure of the head is not-electable as over EUR 100 bn. Either way the buyer's scale is broken.
- **G6:** the kind also carries lot figures in another currency.
- **G1 (confirmed repeated total):** a figure carried by at least 2 summed lots also appears lot-null (any field), or as a procedure figure, in any version of the chain, AND it is at least 1/10 of the largest lot. The 1/10 condition keeps two small equal TED awards from firing it (5995030).
- **G2 (unconfirmed repeated total):** at least 4 lots, and at least half of the lots, share one figure.
- **G3 (one lot is a total):** with at least 3 lots, the largest lot is within 1 % of 10^k x the sum of the others, for k = 0..3.
- **G4 (scale disagreement):** another electable kind on at least 2 of the same lots sums to less than 1/10, or more than 10x, of this sum.

Kind policy: "kind of the elected figure" wins, with awards first only when today's head is null. On the labels, awards-first scores identically: 175096 and 917292 end up the same through G0/G4, and 917292 has no valid awards. The elected kind is preferred because it keeps the head's meaning and is monotone: the served sum is never below today's figure.

Adjacent class (a slip lot beating an admitted or award-copy total): OUT OF SCOPE.
- T never fires when a procedure figure is admitted. 148 heads where a lot beats an admitted procedure figure (B 134, R 14) have 0 changes.
